open_points.subject: read_service_record
open_points.text: read_service_record: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST project the record into ManifestServiceRecord: instances is an object keyed by instance name, so an instance's key in instances becomes instance_name and its class becomes instance_class; an instance's required_headers is an object mapping each header name to its value, as platform manifest records write it, and becomes the tuple of one HeaderField per entry with both texts verbatim, in the record's order, None when the instance states none; exposed_as http_api given as one string, a list or absent becomes the tuple of its routes, and each capability's record_digest is content_identity of the canonical JSON of that one raw capability entry; effect_class stays text.
open_points.other_text: read_manifest_operation: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] idempotency_key None gives an empty idempotency_key_fields, otherwise the trimmed names in manifest order; base_url, required_headers and instance_class come from the instance whose name selected_instance_name gives for the service, each None when no instance is selected or the record lists no instance of that name or the field is missing.
open_points.question: Must a missing required_headers field be projected as None, or is None permitted only when the instance explicitly states none?
